card.summary: SSD KVM 1GB at USD 1.33/month billed USD 16 annually: 2 vCPU, 1 GB RAM, 30 GB SSD, 15 TB traffic, 1 IPv4 with IPv6 available, SolusVM control panel, Chicago ...

free_tier.stated: SSD KVM 1GB at USD 1.33/month billed USD 16 annually: 2 vCPU, 1 GB RAM, 30 GB SSD, 15 TB traffic, 1 IPv4 with IPv6 available, SolusVM control panel, Chicago Illinois (the tracker's location; the site's own menu names 'Looking Glass (Chicago, IL)'). The 2 GB plan is USD 2.00/month billed USD 24 annually with 2 vCPU, 50 GB SSD and 20 TB. Monthly plans sit above it: USD 5 for 4 vCPU, 4 GB, 100 GB SSD and 30 TB, and USD 9 for 4 vCPU, 8 GB, 200 GB SSD and 45 TB. The tracker's cheapest row is the 2 GB plan, so the vendor page carries a cheaper plan than the tracker lists, and its transfer allowances are much larger than the tracker shows. No renewal price is printed on the pages read, and on 2026-11-07 the order pages of the record's plans answer out of stock.

egress.terms: 15 TB a month of traffic is included on the USD 16 plan and 20 TB on the USD 24 plan; no overage price is stated on the page read

record.tooling: the card names 'SolusVM Control Panel'; the site links a VPS panel at vps.tnahosting.net and there are separate panels for hybrid, Ryzen and dedicated lines. No API is documented on the page read
record.chaining: 15 TB of traffic for USD 16 a year, and 30 TB for USD 5 a month on the 4 GB plan, are the largest metered transfer allowances among the USD-priced plans among documented hosts, so this suits a download or mirror node whose bottleneck is bytes rather than CPU

record.notes: This is the clearest tracker gap in this category: the vendor sells a USD 16/year plan that the tracker does not list, so the tracker's USD 24 entry is not the floor. The 15 TB figure is traffic, not storage, and the disk is 30 GB, which is why the annual plan is cheap. The USD 5 monthly 4 GB plan is the better value at 30 TB, and the tracker lists neither plan. Unverified: whether the annual price renews at 16 USD, and what the traffic counter does at 15 TB. Rendering and provenance: currency symbols are written out (EUR, GBP, RUB, VND), diacritics in place names are folded to ASCII, and a price the page splits across two lines is joined as value/period; the tracker page stated 'Database update: 7 hours ago' when it was read on 2026-10-22.
